lastCompletedStory.title: Carry the block origin on the audit-blocked plan result

nextStoryContext: The audit-blocked member of PlanPhaseResult (src/supervisor/plan-runner.ts:284, shifted +7 lines by this story's doc comment) now carries a REQUIRED origin: 'oracle-lint' | 'auditor' field. Both construction sites are updated (runOracleLintCheck sets 'oracle-lint'; the auditor BLOCK branch in runPlanWorkerSequence sets 'auditor'). This story is discriminator-only: the re-plan loop (runPlanPhaseWithReplan) still counts both origins against the single MAX_REPLAN_ROUNDS budget untouched -- a later story in this PRD is expected to split the budget per-origin using this new field. Any other test file that constructs an 'audit-blocked' object literal (grep `kind: 'audit-blocked'` across test/) must include origin; only test/supervisor/plan/plan-runner-postaudit.test.ts had a literal construction (fixture BLOCKED_RESULT) needing the update -- the other two hits were `as {...}` casts on runPlanPhase's return, unaffected by making the field required. File-size ceiling for src/supervisor/plan-runner.ts was raised 2116->2125 in scripts/file-size-budget.json for the added field + doc comment.
